newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - March 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - March 3.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Taiwan women conned into becoming prostitutes in Japan.
Dalai Lama says Taiwan-Tibet relations to improve.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Private clinics in Taiwan to suspend participation in health care scheme.
Senior communist China leader Peng Zhen dead at 95.
LIBERTY TIMES - At least 3,000 dead in Iran earthquake.
Communist China's military spending reaches US$9.7 billion in 1997.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Singapore government is least bureaucratic of all Asian governments.
Taiwan Internet users rise to 1.2 million households.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Taiwan to reduce fire insurance fees for major enterprises.
Manufacturing industry poses highest employment rate since September 1994.
